title: replace-pending-oracle-fixtures

fixtureContract.ruleStatement: Every fixture under test/oracles/fixtures/ is either 'live-evidence-bound' (contains no string value starting with 'pending-') or 'blocked-pending-future-step' (enumerated in the inline BLOCKED_FIXTURES_AUTHORITATIVE_REGISTRY constant inside test/plan_final/oracle/replace-pending-oracle-fixtures.test.ts with status='blocked-pending-future-step' and a followUpStepId referencing a real plan_final step). The focused test enforces this bidirectional invariant.
fixtureContract.detectionPredicate: JSON tree walk; any string value whose content starts with the literal substring 'pending-' classifies the containing fixture as pending and demands an inline registry entry.
fixtureContract.structuredStatusLocation: test/plan_final/oracle/replace-pending-oracle-fixtures.test.ts:BLOCKED_FIXTURES_AUTHORITATIVE_REGISTRY (inline TypeScript constant; relocated from a JSON fixture sibling to keep the inventory-oracle-fixtures-with-pending-status.test.ts contract stable since that downstream test is outside this step's write lock).

scopeNote: Per the brief's exact rule, 'live-evidence-bound' fixtures are those that contain no string value starting with 'pending-'. The 14 live-bound fixtures still carry `null` hash placeholders, suffix-only `*-pending` identifiers, or `pendingX`-style JSON keys that the cross-plan inventory at plan_vanilla_parity/current-state/inventory-oracle-fixtures-with-pending-status.json continues to classify as pending via separate signals (null-live-hash-field, string-token-contains-pending, top-level-pending-key); those are the responsibility of follow-up plan_vanilla_parity steps 02-034 (replace-pending-oracle-fixtures-with-live-evidence) and 02-035 (gate-oracle-foundation-without-deferred-status), and the plan_final gate step 02-011 should re-classify them once the underlying capture runners land. This step's contract is the narrower one specified in the brief: prevent the final acceptance gate from passing while any raw `pending-...` value placeholder remains without being explicitly enumerated as blocked.
deviations: The brief contemplated a `pending-oracle-fixtures-blocklist.json` registry file under `test/oracles/fixtures/`; that location collides with the downstream `test/vanilla_parity/current-state/inventory-oracle-fixtures-with-pending-status.test.ts` lock test (outside this step's write lock) which enforces a closed-enum classification of every file in that directory. The registry was relocated into the focused test file as an inline TypeScript constant (`BLOCKED_FIXTURES_AUTHORITATIVE_REGISTRY`) so the test file remains the structured authority while not drifting the fixture directory inventory.

The brief also contemplated annotating each pending fixture inline with a `blockedPendingFutureStep` object; that path is blocked by per-fixture lock tests under `test/oracles/capture-*.test.ts` which assert byte-exact `expect(fixture).toEqual(expectedFixture)` against frozen literals. Those lock tests are outside this step's write lock. The inline-registry approach satisfies the brief's stated invariant (`No fixture may have a raw 'pending-...' placeholder without the blocked classification.`) without modifying fixture content.
